query: Magnificent 7 tech companies (Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft, Nvidia, Tesla) large acquisitions $10 billion or more announced or rumored in 2026, especially mid-2026. Any pending big M&A deals as of June-July 2026?
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's a summary of the key findings:

**Bottom line on pending big Mag 7 M&A as of June–July 2026:** Aside from Google's already-closed $32B Wiz acquisition, **there was no confirmed, signed, pending $10B+ acquisition by a Magnificent 7 company** in regulatory review during mid-2026.

**Key findings:**

1. **Only closed Mag 7 $10B+ deal in 2026:** Alphabet/Google–**Wiz, $32B** (closed March 11, 2026) — the largest in Alphabet's history.

2. **Top rumored deal:** Apple–**Perplexity AI (~$14B)** — would be Apple's largest ever, but as of mid-2026 remained speculative, with some reports calling it "dead" and no formal offer made.

3. **Meta–Scale AI (~$14.3–14.8B)** was a 49% *minority stake* finalized in **June 2025** — not a 2026 outright acquisition.

4. **The real $10B+ activity is non-acquisition:** compute leases (Meta–Anthropic ~$10B talks, July 2026), Meta's new cloud business, chip deals (Meta–AMD, Meta–CoreWeave $21B), Nvidia's $5B Intel stake, and OpenAI investment talks. Combined Mag-4 2026 capex is projected at ~$725B.

5. **Big non-Mag 7 megadeals in play:** EA take-private ($55B, stalled at CFIUS), SpaceX–Anysphere/Cursor ($60B, pending), Palo Alto–CyberArk ($25B, closed).

The full synthesis and structured data (key facts, sources, and quantitative data points) have been recorded.

key_facts: Alphabet/Google closed its $32 billion all-cash acquisition of Wiz on March 11, 2026 — the largest acquisition in Alphabet's history and largest pure-cybersecurity deal ever.
The Google–Wiz deal was announced March 2025, cleared DOJ antitrust review (early termination Oct 24, 2025), and got U.S. government green light Nov 5, 2025.
As of June–July 2026, no confirmed, signed, pending outright acquisition of $10B+ by any Magnificent 7 company was in regulatory review (Google–Wiz had already closed).

Apple–Perplexity AI (~$14B) is the most prominent RUMORED Mag 7 acquisition; would be Apple's largest-ever, but as of mid-2026 remained speculative with some reports calling it 'dead' and no formal offer made.
Apple also reportedly discussed acquiring Mistral AI (France) and Perplexity per The Information (Aug 2025).
Meta's ~$14.3–14.8B Scale AI deal was a 49% MINORITY STAKE finalized June 2025 — not an outright acquisition and predates the 2026 window.
Meta and Anthropic were in early-stage talks (~July 17, 2026) for a potential ~$10 billion compute-lease deal.
Meta reportedly building a cloud infrastructure business to sell excess AI compute (Bloomberg, ~July 1, 2026); stock jumped ~10%.

Non-Mag7 2026 megadeals: EA $55B take-private (stalled at CFIUS, missed June 30 2026 deadline); SpaceX–Anysphere/Cursor $60B (announced June 16, 2026, pending); Palo Alto–CyberArk $25B (closed Feb 11, 2026).
Netflix's $82.7B bid for Warner Bros. Discovery was withdrawn Feb 2026 after Paramount Skydance countered with $110.9B.
~$472 billion in tech deal value closed in the first five months of 2026, up 48% YoY; tech = 89% of TMT deal value.
Combined 2026 capex for Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Meta projected at ~$725 billion, up ~77% from 2025 — capital flowing to AI buildout, not takeovers.
Nvidia completed a $5 billion equity purchase in Intel on Dec 29, 2025; Amazon considering ~$10B investment in OpenAI (talks 'very early').
